name: NextDNS Manager
tagline: Control your NextDNS privacy settings from your phone
description:
NextDNS Manager makes it easy to manage your NextDNS account right from your Android phone. NextDNS is a service that blocks ads, trackers, and malicious sites at the DNS level, and this app gives you quick access to your settings, logs, and filtering options.

Instead of digging through a website, you can flip settings, check what's been blocked, and fine-tune your protection on the go.
